case.title: The Safe House Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Ashgrove Safe House, the evening turned dark. The sale of government secrets to a buyer from another country has shocked everyone here. The doors are locked, and no one is allowed to leave until the truth comes out. 6 guests are still inside, and every one of them is hiding something. You can search rooms like The Grand Lobby, The Lounge, and The Private Study to find clues. You can talk to each guest to hear their story. But be careful: one guest is not who they say they are. They are using a fake name to hide the truth. Your job is to find that person before they slip away into the night.
case.crime: The sale of government secrets to a buyer from another country
case.target_fake_identity: Diego Alcott, a money investor people trust
case.escape_plan: Diego Alcott plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

timeline.description: The crime happens: the sale of government secrets to a buyer from another country.
The alarm goes off. No one may leave.
Diego Alcott is seen moving toward a side door.

evidence.name: a fake passport
evidence.description: It looks real, but the year of birth is a little bit wrong.

evidence.name: a page from an account book
evidence.description: A page of numbers that do not add up.

evidence.name: a cloth with blood on it
evidence.description: A fine cloth with two letters sewn on it and a dark stain.

evidence.name: muddy shoes
evidence.description: Costly shoes covered in garden mud, but it has not rained inside.

evidence.name: a torn train ticket
evidence.description: A ticket ripped in two. The time on it is earlier than someone said.

evidence.name: a wine glass
evidence.description: A half-full glass. The drink smells bitter.

evidence.name: a cheap phone
evidence.description: A cheap phone with only one number called.

hidden_clues: Diego Alcott's story about where they were does not match the a fake passport.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.
red_herrings: a cloth with blood on it

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a money investor
solution.reasoning: Diego Alcott is the hidden person. The main clues (a fake passport, a page from an account book) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: One of the 6 guests at The Ashgrove Safe House is using a fake name. Look for clues, compare their stories, and unmask the one behind the sale of government secrets to a buyer from another country. Some guests lie. Check their stories carefully.
